variation.description: DetailsOfExpenditureIncurredOnAndProceedsFromTheSaleOfEnvironmentalProtectionInstallation is tagged while ExpenditureOnEnvironmentalProtectionInstallationTaxAdjustment remains untagged, triggering NVAD-E-0780.
